subject: Post-signature: Phased Guardian Rollout, Canary & Eval Plan
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@guardiantech.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@guardiantech.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Signed SOW — ready to kick off MAP and rollout

Connor —

Thanks — SOW is signed and you should have the DocuSign confirmation on your side now. GuardianTech is eager to get the first environment up and validated. Before we schedule the kickoff, Elena and I wanted to confirm a few specifics so we can align our internal ops and security teams: 

- We need a clear canary window (preferred: 2 weeks) where traffic is routed to a reserved pool and degraded to 25% of live load for validation.
- A short evaluation plan to exercise latency/cost/quality tradeoffs on our most common prompts.
- Training plan for our ops and CS teams (two half-day sessions + runbooks).

If you can share a phased MAP that embeds the rollout/canary/migration/training timeline we can lock internal dependencies.

Appreciate it — Samir
Principal Product Manager
GuardianTech

Attachment: Guardian_SOW_signed.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@guardiantech.com>, Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@guardiantech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signed SOW — ready to kick off MAP and rollout

Samir / Elena —

Great news on the SOW — congrats and welcome. I attached an initial MAP workbook (MAP_Guardian_v1.xlsx) and a proposed high-level timeline below. This is intentionally conservative; we can compress once kick-off confirms resource availability. Key highlights: 

1) Week 0 (prep, 1 week): access, onboarding, infra provisioning (dedicated pool + test cluster), baseline performance capture.
2) Week 1-2 (canary stage): limited traffic — 25% synthetic + 10% real via token-tagging. Canary checklist attached (canary-checklist.md). Validation: latency P95 < 300ms, inference cost variance < 15%, quality regression tests (prompt set A) pass >= 95% similarity threshold.
3) Week 3 (migration pilot): shift non-critical routes, run synthetic soak, rollback window 48h.
4) Week 4-6 (full rollout + training): staged ramp to 100% with three training sessions (ops runbook, CS playbook, QA handoff).

Owner assignments are in the MAP workbook. Laura — can you confirm we can reserve the Dedicated pool for the 2-week canary starting Aug 17? Marissa — please confirm training slot availability weeks 4–6.

Open items for Guardian: list of top 30 prompts for eval set; security contact for KMS/HSM review; SLA acceptance criteria for final signoff.

Proposed kickoff meeting: Aug 12, 10:00 PT (30 min) — agenda: roles, access, canary gating criteria, immediate blockers.

Thanks — Connor
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_Guardian_v1.xlsx; canary-checklist.md

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@guardiantech.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signed SOW — ready to kick off MAP and rollout

Connor —

I've reserved the Dedicated GPU pool for Aug 17–30 for the two-week canary window. Note a couple operational constraints: 

- Autoscale burst capacity is limited on weekdays 12:00–18:00 PT due to maintenance in that region; we'll schedule heavy soak outside that window.
- We'll set up a parallel test VPC for Guardian's staging traffic to avoid cross-tenant noise.

Marissa — training: I can run the ops-focused session week 4 (Aug 31) and a follow-up deep-dive Sept 2. Can you coordinate CS/QA sessions on Sept 1 + Sept 3 (afternoon)?

Sergio — please confirm canary telemetry dashboard (token-cost breakdown, latency by route, eval pass rate) will be ready prior to Aug 17.

--Laura
Head of Customer Onboarding, Redwood Inference

- For canary tagging: we'll use header X-Guardian-Canary: true for 10% live sampling and a synthetic load generator for the remaining 15%.
- Security: our security lead (cc'd as Samir) will send the KMS contact details tomorrow.
